title: Theorizing the Human Sciences in the Age of Absolute Disruption: Historical Criticism and Its Remainders
abstract: Adam DJ Brett reads Jason Ānanda Josephson-Storm’s trilogy — The Myth of Disenchantment, Metamodernism, and The Genealogy of Genealogy — as one project asking whether a thing exists, how it arose, what grounds our claims about it, and whether it is desirable.
